# stata-codex-skills

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/stata-codex-skills
Purpose: Build local Codex skills for built-in Stata, community packages, and
Stata C/C++ plugins.

## Authority

- `content/**/*.yaml` is the sole executable publication source.
- `config/` defines deterministic routing and compatibility aliases.
- `locks/` and `manifests/` record provenance; they do not control publication.
- `build/generated/` is derived, ignored, and never edited by hand.

## Entry points

- `README.md`: workflow, validation boundaries, publication, and recovery
- `Makefile`: frozen build, checks, licensed validation, and publication
- `scripts/render_skills.py`: deterministic transactional renderer
- `scripts/lint_skill_pack.py`: schema, routing, provenance, lock, and output lint
- `scripts/validate_skill_pack.py`: static and licensed integration suites
- `scripts/publish_local.py`: receipt-gated three-skill publication
- `tests/prompts/cases.yaml`: independently written routing fixtures

## Core commands

```text
make bootstrap
make doctor
make check
make validate
make publish
```

`make check` is offline and does not invoke Stata. `make validate` requires
licensed Stata, package-network access, and plugin compilation. Plugin execution
is an explicit optional integration test, not part of the default gate.

## Safety and reuse

- Treat this repository as public: no PHI, restricted data, credentials,
  private drafts, proprietary help text, generated outputs, or package code.
- Package installation requires user authorization and an isolated Stata path.
- Publication requires a fresh digest-bound receipt and preserves uncertain
  transaction state for exact-path human recovery.
- Codex skills are installed per machine under `~/.codex/skills/` or
  `$CODEX_HOME/skills/`; installation does not synchronize across machines.
